blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Text-to-image models have made tremendous progress and can produce high-quality images. However, a question which would be asked in any other discipline is where the frontier models fall short. We introduce GenOlympiad, a benchmark which provides the most challenging text prompts from nine capability axes for stress-testing frontier text-to-image models. The assessed capabilities include generating large quantities, performing deep reasoning, ensuring hard physical consistency, following complex rules and so on. The prompts are designed such that prompt alignment is visually verifiable (e.g., counting) instead of relying on subjectiveness (e.g., style). Based on this, we develop an automated evaluation framework which decomposes the prompt into easy and hard questions, and for most hard questions, draws help lines to ground evidence for accurate grading. We evaluate 20+ strong text-to-image models, including Nano Banana Pro, GPT-Image-2.5, Seedream-5.0 and so on. We report that even the best-performing T2I model (Nano Banana Pro) only achieves a strict score of 23.9 out of 100 and that coding models such as GPT-6 Astra have higher prompt alignment scores (but not as visually pleasing). We also derive insights in model evolution, alignment with Elo scores, and effectiveness of our grounding-based evaluation protocol. Code is available at https://github.com/GenOlympiad/GenOlympiad and the project page is at https://genolympiad.github.io/

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: In artificial intelligence, benchmarks are introduced to expose frontier models to their capability boundaries, measure them, and seek solutions from the community. Some well known examples include ObjectNet ( Barbu et al., 2019 ) for vision model generalization, Humanity’s Last Exam ( Center for AI Safety et al., 2026 ) for LLM question answering across subjects, SWE-bench ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) for automatic issue resolution, ARC-AGI benchmarks ( Chollet, 2019 ; Chollet et al., 2025 ) for general intelligence, and FrontierMath ( Glazer et al., 2024 ) for testing AI on advanced mathematics.
blocks.zh: 在人工智能中,引入了使前沿模型暴露于其能力界限,测量它们,并寻求社区解决方案的基准. 一些知名的例子包括ObjectNet(Barbu等人,2019年)用于视觉模型泛化,Human 's Last Exam(Centre for AI Safety等人,2026年)用于跨主题的LLM问题解答,SWE-bench(Jimenez等人,2024年)用于自动问题解答,ARC-AGI基准(Chollet,2019年;Chollet等人,2025年)用于一般智能,FrontialMath(Glazer等人,2024年)用于测试AI的高级数学.

blocks.en:
Frontier text-to-image models can now produce high quality images ( Sani et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ) . This is evidenced by both real user scoring, where platforms like Artificial Analysis Arena rank models by asking users to compare image pairs head-to-head, and strong scores on automatic benchmarks. GenEval ( Ghosh et al., 2023 ) has risen from 0.61 when first introduced in 2023 to ∼ \sim 0.90 for recent models. PRISM-Bench ( Fang et al., 2026 ) score which measures image-text alignment and aesthetics is now over 85 by Nano Banana.
However, these evaluation platforms either do not diagnose limitations of models (e.g., AA Arena) or see scores being saturated (e.g., GenEval) and thus no longer sit at capability boundaries. Therefore, we ask the question: when generated images already look high-quality, where do frontier image models still fail?

blocks.en: We introduce GenOlympiad, an exam of 801 hardest prompts for frontier model evaluation, co-designed by AI and human. The prompts span nine capability axes, including quantity and precision, latent computation, physical consistency, spatial and 3D reasoning. To be hard, instead of adding more objects or textual conditions, the GenOlympiad prompts focus on hard constraints that must be strictly satisfied. An example prompt is ‘a compass on a boat, with its needle pointing toward the setting sun’: although frontier models can generate realistic lighting and textures, they usually fail to satisfy the constraint of ‘needle pointing towards the setting sun’, which is what we assess.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍GenOlympiad, 由AI和人类共同设计, 提示跨越9个能力轴,包括数量和精度、潜在计算、物理一致性、空间和三维推理。 要硬起来,GenOlympiad并没有增加更多的对象或文字条件,而是促使人们关注必须严格满足的硬约束. 一个例子是“船上的指南针,它的针头指向落日 ” : 虽然前沿模型可以产生现实的照明和纹理,但它们通常无法满足“需要指向落日 ” 的束缚,而这正是我们所评估的。

blocks.en: Given each GenOlympiad prompt and an image generated by a frontier model, we design an automatic pipeline to score the generations, which focuses on constraint satisfaction instead of general alignment. Specifically, we do not ask the vision language model (VLM) ‘are there eight blue caps’, because the answer can often be wrong. Instead, we break it down to atomic tasks, e.g. , detecting all the blue caps, drawing the bounding boxes on the image, and asking whether each bounding box contains a blue cap. Evaluation becomes more accurate and interpretable if we let the VLM perform such simple evidence extraction tasks and ground the task results (drawing bounding boxes and help lines). Our scoring function is deterministic, matching the extracted evidence ( e.g. , bounding boxes height, width, and coordinates) against the prompt. In addition, when grounding fails, we withhold the task instead of assigning an unreliable score.
blocks.zh: 鉴于GenOlympiad的每一个即时和边疆模型产生的图像,我们设计了一个自动管道来评分这几代人,它侧重于约束性满足而不是一般的对齐. 具体来说,我们不问视觉语言模型`是否有8个蓝帽 ' ,因为答案往往是错误的。 相反,我们把它细分为原子任务,例如,检测所有蓝盖,在图像上绘制边框,并询问每个边框是否包含蓝盖. 如果我们让虚拟LM执行如此简单的证据提取任务,并整理任务结果(绘制边框和帮助线),评价就更加准确和可解释。 我们的评分功能是确定性,将提取的证据(例如,边框高度、宽度和坐标)与及时性相匹配。 此外,如果搁浅失败,我们不承担任务,而不是分配不可靠的分数。

blocks.en:
We evaluate a suite of frontier models on GenOlympiad with our evaluation protocols. We report strict score which requires all constraints in a task to be correct, and relaxed score which gives a partial score for some constraints. Detailed definition is in Section 5 . Nano Banana Pro gains 23.9 in strict score and 40.0 in relaxed score out of 100, ranking first among T2I models, while the latest GPT-Image-2.5-sunburst ranks second at 14.9 in strict score and 29.6 in relaxed score.
We also find that frontier closed models, e.g., the GPT-Image family, exhibit better GenOlympiad scores with their new releases, while open-weight image models have mixed results, suggesting that the latter may not have been trained at the boundary. In sum, this paper has the following main points.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Some popular benchmarks focus on object presence and attributes like color, relations or counting of a few objects ( Ghosh et al., 2023 ; Kamath et al., 2025 ; Paiss et al., 2023 ; Ye et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025 ) . Others focus on creative images that rarely appear in the training set ( Wu et al., 2024 ) or long prompt following, such as DPG-Bench ( Hu et al., 2024 ) and TIIF-Bench ( Wei et al., 2025 ) . Recently, more challenging benchmarks are introduced by adding reasoning, e.g. , Einstein’s favorite instrument ( Li et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Sun et al., 2026 ; Niu et al., 2025 ; Singh & Zheng, 2023 ; Chang et al., 2025 ) . Tasks in GenExam ( Wang et al., 2025 ) reflect various disciplines such as history, music, and biology, while MathGen ( Liu et al., 2026 ) focuses on mathematics content, e.g. , angles, function, set and counting tasks with many objects. Prompts in Qwen-Image-Bench ( Li et al., 2026 ) and ImagenWorld ( Sani et al., 2026 ) instead reflect real design demand in games, products, fashion, etc . Earlier benchmarks like GenEval have already been saturated to 90%.
Frontier models also made rapid improvement on recent benchmark, e.g. , GenExam reports a 74.6% strict score for GPT-Image-2; while MathGen report 53.7% pass rate (similar to strict score) for Nano Banana Pro. In comparison, GenOlympiad curates the hardest prompts and only sees 23.9% and 14.9% of Nano Banana Pro and GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst.

一些流行的基准侧重于物体的存在和属性,如颜色、关系或少数物体的计数(Ghosh等人,2023年;Kamath等人,2025年;Paiss等人,2023年;Ye等人,2025年;Huang等人,2025年)。 其他人则专注于很少出现在训练集(Wu等人,2024年)或长时间的即时后传的创作画面,如DPG-Bench(Hu等人,2024年)和TIIF-Bench(Wei等人,2025年). 最近,通过增加推理引入了更具挑战性的基准,例如爱因斯坦最喜欢的仪器(Li等人,2024年;Chen等人,2025年;Sun等人,2026年;Niu等人,2025年;Singh & Zheng,2025年)。 2023; 张等, 2025). GenExam中的任务(Wang et al.,2025)反映了历史,音乐,生物学等多个学科,而MathGen(Liu et al.,2026)则侧重于数学内容,如角度,功能,设定和计数任务与许多对象. Quen-Image-Bench (Li et al., 2026)和ImingnWorld (Sani et al., 2026)中的提示相反反映了游戏,产品,时尚等中的真实设计需求. 像GenEval这样的早期基准已经饱和到90%.
边疆模型也快速改进了最近的基准,例如,GenExam报告GPT-Image-2的严格分数为74.6%;而MathGen报告Nano Banana Pro的通过率(类似于严格分数)为53.7%。 相比之下,GenOlympiad解析了最难的催眠药,只看到Nano Banana Pro和GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst的23.9%和14.9%。

blocks.en:
Early metrics like Inception Score (IS) ( Salimans et al., 2016 ) and Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) ( Heusel et al., 2017 ) measure how realistic images are. Later metrics focus more on image-text alignment. CLIPScore ( Hessel et al., 2021 ) calculates the similarity between prompt and image, which is not strongly correlated with human judgement ( Ghosh et al., 2023 ) . Human based metrics like Elo in Artificial Analysis Image Arena was later adopted, but such metrics are too expensive to use and do not diagnose limitations of models. VQA-based automatic metrics mitigate these problems ( Hu et al., 2023 ; Cho et al., 2024 ; Lin et al., 2024 ) by directly applying VQA models to image-question pairs. Other evaluation methods use vision tools to obtain important evidence about texts or objects, e.g. ,
GenEval ( Ghosh et al., 2023 ) uses detection models; MathGen ( Liu et al., 2026 ) uses OCR, contour detection, etc to extract text, angles, etc . GenOlympiad is similar to GenExam/TIFA/DA-Score in breaking the prompt into questions, but is different in using visual grounding in evaluation. GenOlympiad also shares similarity with GenEval/MathGen and thinking with images ( Yang et al., 2025 ) in using vision tool for evidence collection; our key difference is using an iterative process to improve grounding (Table 3 ).

CLIPScore(Hessel等人,2021年)计算出即时和图像的相似性,这与人类判断没有紧密关联(Ghosh等人,2023年). 人工分析影像竞技场中的埃洛等基于人类的度量衡后来被采用,但这种度量衡过于昂贵,无法使用,也不诊断模型的局限性. 基于VQA的自动度量衡减轻了这些问题(Hu等人,2023;Cho等人,2024;Lin等人,2024)。 其他评价方法使用视觉工具获取有关文本或物品的重要证据,例如:

blocks.en: The 801 tasks in GenOlympiad overall evaluate nine capability axes below (topic distribution in Fig. 3 ). More example prompts and success/failure images are shown in Appendix Fig. 1 and Fig. 17 .

blocks.en: • Quantity and precision: to generate a large number of objects, exact ratio between objects, precise angles, and precise readings of instrument like ruler. • Latent computation: computation outcome does not appear in the prompt, requiring the system to analyze the state for generation, e.g. , 23 dice which sum up to 131 . • Physical consistency: to follow real-world physical constraints like gravity, optics, and stress, e.g. , water jets from different heights land at different ground locations . • Spatial and 3D reasoning: examine the correctness of perspective relations and the expand diagram of 3D objects, e.g. , a picture should be drawn in 3-point perspective . • Text fidelity: readable text with constraints like font size and language habits like inverted question mark in Spanish, e.g. , a paper printed with 12 lines of rhyme, each line ending with -ation . • Symbolic systems: follow symbols in circuit, molecular graph, music sheet, etc , e.g. , draw ClCCC1CCC(CC(=O)C2CCC(C(C)CC)C2)CC1 as a line-angle (skeletal) structural formula . • Long-range consistency: parts of an image, even parts far apart, should be consistent, e.g. , consistency of character in hats, clothes and rings in a multi-panel comic. • Counterfactual instruction following: prompt is opposite to commonsense knowledge, e.g. , a football team that gets the lowest score celebrate for its loss . • World-knowledge grounding: to follow commonsense knowledge e.g. , flags of countries; real-time information e.g. , current air quality; The time difference between two specific countries should be correct.

blocks.en: 3.3 Evaluation framework
blocks.zh: 3.3 评价框架

blocks.en: We design an automatic pipeline, which runs the evaluation program defined in Section 3.1 , to grade how well a generated image follows the prompt.
blocks.zh: 我们设计了一个自动管道,运行第3.1节界定的评价程序,对生成的图像跟随提示的程度进行分级。

blocks.en: Easy questions easily asked. We use a TIFA-style method for easy question evaluation: the judge VLM takes the easy question and the generated image as input and answers yes or no. Asking once is enough, since the agreement with human answers is 94.7%, and majority voting over 3 independent queries only slightly improves it to 95.3% at extra cost. As shown in Fig. 2 , only after all easy questions have been passed will we proceed with the hard questions; otherwise, we directly mark 0.
blocks.zh: 很容易问问题 我们使用TIFA式的方法来进行简单的问题评价:法官VLM将简单的问题和生成的图像作为输入和回答是或否. 问一次就够了,因为与人类答案的协议是94.7%,多数人对3个独立询问的投票只略微改善到95.3%,而额外的成本. 如图2所示,只有在所有容易的问题都通过之后,我们才能着手处理困难的问题;否则,我们直接标出0。

blocks.en:
Grounding visual evidence for hard questions. 557 out of 801 tasks in GenOlympiad require evidence grounding.
Depending on questions, we draw different helping lines on the generated image. As shown in Fig. 4 , for counting questions, we aim to draw bounding boxes of objects of interest; for the compass-sun question, we aim to draw an extension line of the compass pointer and contour of the sun. There is no guarantee that grounding is successful at the first try, so after each try, we ask the VLM whether grounding is successful, such as ‘does the blue line correctly overlay with the compass pointer?’ If successful, then grounding is complete; if not successful, we repeat the grounding step until reaching maximum trial times. The grounded evidence, e.g. , bounding boxes and lines, is then processed by a deterministic program. The program performs bespoke operations, such as counting bounding boxes, calculating the sum of dice or checking whether the compass-pointer line intersects the contour of the sun, to determine whether the hard question is satisfied.
blocks.zh:
将视觉证据作为硬问题的基础。 在GenOlympiad的801项任务中,有557项需要证据。
根据问题,我们在生成的图像上绘制不同的帮助线. 如图4所示,关于计算问题,我们的目标是绘制利益对象的边框;关于罗盘-太阳问题,我们的目标是绘制罗盘指针和太阳轮廓的延伸线。 无法保证地面在第一次尝试时是成功的,所以在每次尝试后,我们都会问VLM是否成功,比如“蓝线是否正确覆盖了指南针?” 如果成功,那么地面工作就已完成;如果不成功,我们就重复地面工作,直到达到最高审判时间。 依据的证据,例如,捆绑的盒子和线条,然后由一个确定程序处理。 程序执行标语操作,如计数边框,计算骰子和数,或检查罗盘-指针线是否交叉太阳轮廓,以确定硬问题是否满足.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Pipeline of evidence grounding. Given a hard question and the generated image (left), we draw helping lines on the image, e.g. , bounding boxes for counting problems, boundaries for the sun, and extension lines for the compass pointer. The type of helping line is decided in the evaluation program. To make the lines accurate, we design an iterative process (middle), where we use Gemini 2.5 Flash to decide whether each line serves the purpose, until success or running out of budget. The grounding result (right) is finally used to decide whether the hard constraint is satisfied.
blocks.zh: 图 4: 证据管道搁浅. 鉴于一个困难的问题和生成的图像(左),我们在图像上绘制帮助线,例如,为计算问题而设定边框,为太阳设定边框,为指南针指针扩展线. 帮助线的类型由评价方案决定. 为了使线路准确,我们设计了一个迭代过程(中间),我们用双子座2.5 Flash来决定每条线路是否达到目的,直到成功或预算耗尽. 基础结果(right)最终被用来决定硬约束是否得到满足.

blocks.en: Figure 5: An example pipeline of deterministic scoring. We write the grounding result into a JSON state file, which, for each die, lists the bounding box height, width, and center coordinates, and the displayed number. We use a deterministic Python script to count the number of dice and the sum of the numbers for grading. The entire deterministic scoring pipeline is provided in the evaluation program. Prompt is the same as Fig. 2 .
blocks.zh: 图5:确定性评分的一个实例。 我们把落地结果写成一个JSON状态文件,文件对每一个死亡者都列出边框高度,宽度,和中心坐标,以及显示的数字. 我们用一个定型的 Python 脚本来计算骰子数和计分数的总和. 整个确定性评分管道由评价方案提供。 速率和图2一样

blocks.en:
Deterministic scoring. After each hard question has been verified, the scoring method will count the number of hard questions that are successfully reflected in the generated image.
For example, there are two hard questions for Fig. 5 : (1) is the number of dice 23; (2) do these dice sum up to 131?
Following GenExam ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , we report two scores. In our ‘strict’ scoring, only when all the hard questions are successfully passed will we give a mark of 100. In the ‘relaxed’ setting, different hard questions have different weights, and the weight sum of the successful ones is the final score. The strict score is the percentage of the scored tasks that pass all the hard questions.
blocks.zh:
定慧评分. 在每个硬质问题被验证后,评分方法将计算出在生成的图像中成功反映的硬质问题的数量.
例如,图5有两个难题:(1)骰子数是23;(2)这些骰子总和是131吗?
继GenExam(Wang et al., 2025)之后,我们报告两个分数. 在我们的 " 严格 " 评分中,只有当所有困难问题都成功通过时,我们才会给出100的标记。 在“放松”的设定中,不同的困难问题有不同的权重,成功的权重总和是最终的分数。 严格的分数是通过所有难题的得分任务的百分比.

blocks.en: Grounding failure. If grounding is unsuccessful after the maximum number of trials, we remove the task rather than force the grader to produce a potentially unreliable score. The failure scenarios may be: an object is too small; object color is very close to the background; many objects overlay each other and can not be clearly located. Grounding may also fail if a rendered text is not recognizable or the generated objects do not match the objects expected by the evaluation program. We rank models according to their grounding failure rate in Fig. 6 .
blocks.zh: 着陆故障。 如果在试验次数最多之后没有成功,我们就去掉任务,而不是强迫分级员得出可能不可靠的分数。 失败情形可能是:一个对象太小;对象颜色与背景非常接近;许多对象相互覆盖,无法清晰定位. 如果一个文本无法识别,或者生成的对象与评价程序预期的对象不匹配,则定位也可能失败。 我们根据模型在图6中的故障率进行排名。

blocks.en: We benchmark the following T2I models: GPT-Image 1, 1.5, 2, and 2.5 Sunburst ( OpenAI, 2025b ; OpenAI, 2025c ; OpenAI, 2026c ; OpenAI, 2026d ) ; Nano Banana, Nano Banana Pro, and Nano Banana 2 ( Google, 2025a ; Google, 2025b ; Google, 2026 ) ; Seedream 4.5 and 5.0 Pro ( ByteDance Seed, 2025 ; ByteDance Seed, 2026 ) ; FLUX.2 Pro, dev, and Klein ( Black Forest Labs, 2025 ) ; FLUX.1 dev and Schnell ( Black Forest Labs, 2024 ) ; Stable Diffusion 3.5 ( Esser et al., 2024 ; Stability AI, 2024 ) ; SANA ( Xie et al., 2025 ) ; and Qwen-Image-20B ( Wu et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们以下列T2I模式为基准:GPT-Image 1、1.5、2和2.5 Sunburst(OpenAI,2025b;OpenAI,2025c;OpenAI,2026c;OpenAI,2026d);Nano Banana, Nano Banana Pro,和 Nano Banana 2 (Google,2025a;Google,2025b;Google,2026);种子梦4.5和5.0 Pro(字节舞曲) 种子,2025年;ByteDance种子,2026年;FLUX.2 Pro, dev,和Klein(黑森林实验室,2025年);FLUX.1 dev和Schnell(黑森林实验室,2024年);稳定扩散3.5(Esser等人,2024年;稳定AI,2024年);SANA(Xie等人,2025年);Quen-Image-20B(Wu等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: We evaluate open-weight models ranging from 0.6B to 20B parameters on the same server with a single NVIDIA A100 80GB GPU. For each model family, we configure the context length of the primary text-conditioning encoder to make the full prompt visible whenever possible. If prompt length exceeds the context length, it will neither generate nor be calculated into the overall score.
blocks.zh: 我们用单一的NVIDIA A100 80GB GPU在同一个服务器上评价0.6B到20B参数的开放量模型. 对于每个型号家族,我们配置主文本调制编码器的上下文长度,尽可能使全速可见. 如果迅速长度超过上下文长度,则不会生成,也不会被计算为总体分数.

blocks.en: We also benchmark two coding models, i.e. , GPT-6 Astra ( OpenAI, 2026b ) , GPT-5.6 Sol ( OpenAI, 2026a ) in medium effort with internet accessibility. We insert a system prompt (See Appendix A.4 ) to let the coding models write a single HTML document. The content on this document is rendered programmatically by JavaScript. We evaluate image aesthetics using the same method and setup as PRISM-Bench ( Fang et al., 2026 ) , where the evaluator is GPT-4.1 ( OpenAI, 2025a ) .
blocks.zh: 我们还将两种编码模型作为基准,即GPT-6 Astra(OpenAI, 2026b),GPT-5.6 Sol(OpenAI, 2026a),在互联网无障碍方面做出了中等努力。 我们插入一个系统提示(见附录A.4),让编码模型写一个单一的HTML文档. 此文档的内容由 JavaScript 程序化渲染. 我们使用与PISM-Bench(Fang等人,2026年)相同的方法和设置来评价图像美学,评价者是GPT-4.1(OpenAI,2025a)。 。 。 。

blocks.en: Prompt engineering (PE) analysis. We test whether prompt rewriting is useful for GenOlympiad. We use GPT-Image-2.5 as the base model. We compare PromptEnhancer-32B and GPT-5.6 Sol for prompt rewriting while keeping the image model and evaluator unchanged. Results are shown in Table 1 . PromptEnhancer-32B brings nearly no overall improvement over GPT-Image-2.5, while GPT-5.6 Sol increases the strict score and relaxed score from 14.9 to 33.0 and from 29.6 to 48.9, respectively. The gain is significant in latent computation and text fidelity and very limited in spatial and 3D reasoning. This demonstrates the usefulness of PE in T2I system design.

blocks.en: Coding models and aesthetics. Coding models generally have higher GenOlympiad scores than T2I models. For example, the strict scores of GPT-6 Astra and Nano Banana Pro are 40.5 and 23.9, respectively. This is because our evaluation focuses on reasoning, where these frontier models are strong. On the other hand, it is also expected that the aesthetic score of coding models is often lower than the strong T2I models (refer Table 3 and Appendix Fig. 16 ). For example, the aesthetic scores of GPT-5.6 Sol and GPT-Image-2.5 are 4.61 and 5.51, respectively.
blocks.zh: 编码模型与美学. 编码模型一般具有比T2I模型更高的GenOlympiad分数. 例如,GPT-6 Astra和Nano Banana Pro的严格分数分别为40.5和23.9。 这是因为我们的评估侧重于推理,在这些前沿模式很强的地方。 另一方面,预计编码模型的审美分数往往低于强大的T2I模型(参见表3和附录图16). 例如,GPT-5.6 Sol和GPT-Image-2.5的审美分数分别为4.61和5.51.

blocks.en:
Case study: GPT-Image-2 vs . Nano Banana 2. They have comparable performance as shown in Table 1 . GPT-Image-2 scores higher on text fidelity, symbolic systems, and 3D reasoning, while Nano Banana 2 is better on world-knowledge grounding, physical consistency, latent computation, and long-range consistency.
It suggests that they were trained on different data. Meanwhile, a lower overall score does not necessarily mean that a model has lower scores on every capability axis.
blocks.zh:
案例研究:GPT-Image-2 vs. 纳诺香蕉 2. 如表1所示,它们的业绩相当。 GPT-Image-2在文本忠诚度,符号系统,和3D推理方面得分较高,而纳诺香蕉2则在世界知识地基,物理一致性,潜伏计算,以及远程一致性方面表现较好.
这表明他们接受了不同数据的培训。 同时,总体分数较低并不一定意味着一个模型在每个能力轴上的分数较低.

blocks.en: 4.3 Further Analysis and Insights
blocks.zh: 4.3 进一步分析和见解

blocks.en: Comparing grounding failure rates across models. As discussed in Section 3.3 , grounding failures happen when some generated content cannot be grounded by Gemini 2.5 Flash. This does not always mean bad generation: occluded objects may cause failure but may not be bad. In Fig. 6 , we compare the 25 models of their grounding failures and find that their ranking highly correlates with their GenOlympiad scores (strict) with a Spearman coefficient of -0.92. It suggests that a stronger model also tends to produce more easily grounded objects, which could be a result of post-training.
blocks.zh: 将各模型的故障率进行比较。 如第3.3节所述,当一些生成的内容不能由双子座2.5 Flash作为依据时,就会出现故障。 这并不总是意味着不良的生成:被占有的物体可能会造成故障,但也可能不是坏的. 在图6中,我们比较了25种模型的定位失败,发现它们的排名与它们的GenOlympiad分数(限制性)高度相关,Spearman系数为-0.92。 这表明,一个更强大的模式也倾向于产生更容易被禁足的物体,这可能是训练后的结果.

blocks.en: Do frontier models improve on GenOlympiad across releases? We evaluate different releases of frontier models e.g. , GPT-Image series, Seedream series, Nano Banana series. Fig. 7 visualizes Table 1 as radar charts.. Later releases generally achieve higher scores, but the improvements are highly uneven across axes. Some capabilities, such as text, spatial reasoning, and latent computation, improve substantially, while others, such as world knowledge, show much slower progress.
blocks.zh: 在GenOlympiad的释放中,前沿模型是否有改进? 我们评价不同版本的前沿模型,例如GPT-Image系列,Seedream系列,纳米香蕉系列. 图7可视化表1为雷达图. 后来的发行一般能达到更高的分数,但各轴的改进极不平衡. 一些能力,如文字、空间推理和潜在计算,大有改进,而另一些能力,如世界知识,则显示进展慢得多。

blocks.en: Correlation of GenOlympiad scores with human-based arena scores. We also analyze the correlation between GenOlympiad scores with human-based arena scores. The latter includes Image Arena, LMArena and Design Arena. Correlation results are shown in Fig. 8 . Although not intended, we observe strong correlation between GenOlympiad score and the arena scores. In other words, models that human prefers often obtain higher scores on GenOlympiad. On the other hand, outliers do exist. For example, Nano Banana Pro has much higher GenOlympiad score but only ranks in the middle of the three arenas. It indicates that differences exist between GenOlympiad and arenas.
blocks.zh: 将GenOlympiad的分数与人类的竞技场分数联系起来. 我们还分析GenOlympiad得分与人类竞技场得分的相互关系. 后者包括图像竞技场,LMArena和设计竞技场. 图8显示了相关结果。 虽然不是有意的,但我们观察到GenOlympiad得分和竞技场得分之间的紧密关联. 换句话说,人类喜欢的模型往往在GenOlympiad上获得更高的分数. 另一方面,外来者确实存在。 例如纳米香蕉 Pro的GenOlympiad得分要高得多,但只在三个竞技场的中间排名. 它表明,GenOlympiad与竞技场之间存在差异.

blocks.en: Figure 8: Correlation between GenOlympiad relaxed scores and three human-preference-based arena scores. OneIG-Bench is included for comparison. GenOlympiad seems to be a good proxy of Elo scores. Results for other benchmarks are shown in Appendix Fig. 15 .
blocks.zh: 图8:GenOlympiad放松分数与基于人类的3个竞技场分数之间的关联. 将OneIG-Bench列入比较范围。 GenOlympiad似乎是埃罗分数的好代表. 其他基准的结果见附录图15。

blocks.en: 4.4 Evaluator validation
blocks.zh: 4.4 (中文(简体) ). 评价员鉴定

blocks.en: Agreement with human judgment. We check how the automatic evaluation protocol agrees with humans. So we recruited 41 annotators on Prolific and collected human answers for 365 questions consisting of 131 easy questions and 234 hard questions. The evaluated images were generated by five T2I models and randomly selected. Annotators see the same generated image and the same questions in our evaluation program but do not see the model name, the VLM answers, or the final score. Each question was assigned to 3 annotators, and we use the majority answer as the human answer. The human answers are then sent to the same deterministic scoring program described in Section 5 for the final decision, e.g. , the true/false answer of ‘Do these dice sum up to 131?’.
blocks.zh: 同意人类的判断 我们检查一下自动评估协议如何与人类一致. 因此,我们招募了41名普罗利菲克的注释员,并收集了365个问题的人的答案,包括131个简单问题和234个硬问题. 被评价的图像由五个T2I模型生成,并随机选择. 注释者在我们的评价方案中看到同样的生成的图像和同样的问题,但没有看到模型名称,VLM答案,或者最终的分数. 每个问题都交给了三个注释员,我们把多数答案作为人性的答案. 然后将人类的答案发送给第5节中描述的同一确定性评分方案,以便作出最后决定,例如,“这些骰子是否总结到131?”

blocks.en: From Table 3 , we have two observations. First, the pass/fail agreement between human and automatic evaluation is 95.3%(348/365). The agreement is 94.7% (124/131) on easy questions and 95.7% (224/234) on hard. Second, evidence grounding is effective. We test this on 117 questions that require evidence grounding, and here the agreement means that the answer is the same as the human answer. If we directly ask VLM without grounding, the agreement between human and VLM is 68.4% (80/117). When we perform evidence grounding, the agreement becomes 91.5% (107/117).
blocks.zh: 从表3来看,我们有两个看法。 首先,人与自动评价的通过/失败协议为95.3%(348/365). 该协议在简单问题上为94.7%(124/131),在硬质问题上为95.7%(224/234). 第二,证据依据是有效的。 我们在需要证据依据的117个问题上检验这一点,在这里,协议意味着答案与人类答案相同。 如果我们直接问VLM而不提出理由,人类和VLM之间的协议为68.4%(80/117). 提供证据后,协议占91.5%(107/117)。

blocks.en: Table 4: Pairwise agreement between three different VLM judges on the same 365 set of human evaluation questions.
blocks.zh: 表4:3名不同的VLM法官就相同的365组人评价问题达成了对等协议.

blocks.en: Agreement between different VLMs. By default we use Gemini 2.5 Flash to answer the evaluation questions, mainly because of the low cost. Here we replace Gemini 2.5 Flash with GPT-5.6 and GPT-4.1 on the same human-study questions and keep the deterministic scoring part unchanged. The pairwise agreement between the three VLM judges is consistently greater than 96%, as shown in Table 4 . It suggests that our evaluation protocol is robust with the current judge.
blocks.zh: 不同地雷危险物质之间的协议。 默认情况下,我们使用双子座2.5 Flash来回答评价问题,这主要是因为成本低. 在这里,我们用GPT-5.6和GPT-4.1取代双子2.5 Flash处理同样的人文研究问题,并保持定点评分部分不变. 如表4所示,3名普通法官之间的对等协议始终大于96%。 这表明我们与现任法官的评估协议是有力的。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduce GenOlympiad, a challenging set of generation tasks covering nine capability axes to find where frontier T2I models fail. Each prompt has an evaluation program of easy and hard questions with 2.2 hard questions on average. We propose a grounding method for such hard question, where we draw helping lines on the image in an iterative way. We show that this method improves agreement with human judgments.We benchmark many strong models including open-source and close-source T2I models and show that the best T2I model, Nano Banana Pro, only has a strict score of 23.9. While coding models have higher strict score of 40.5, they suffer from poorer aesthetics. We also derive interesting insights, e.g. , how a model family improves with their newer releases, prompt enhancer is useful, and GenOlympiad scores strongly correlate with human Elo scores.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍GenOlympiad,一套具有挑战性的生成任务,涵盖9个能力轴,以寻找前沿T2I模型失败之处. 每个提示都有一个简单和难题的评价方案,平均有2.2个难题。 我们建议了这样一个难题的基础方法,在这个方法中,我们以迭代的方式在图像上绘制帮助线. 我们显示,这种方法改善了与人类判断的一致性。 我们以许多强力模型为基准,包括开源和近源T2I模型,并显示最佳T2I模型Nano Banana Pro只有23.9的严格得分. 虽然编码模型的严格分数较高,为40.5分,但美学较差。 我们还得出了有趣的见解,例如,模型家庭如何随着更新的释放而改善,即时增强器是有用的,GenOlympiad的得分与人类埃洛的得分密切相关。

blocks.en: Limitation. GenOlympiad focuses on prompts that current frontier models find difficult, so the scores do not represent their performance on easy prompts. Moreover, GenOlympiad offers limited signal for non-frontier T2I models. Some prompts in GenOlympiad are too long to fit into the context of open-weight models, so for some open-source models, around 20 tasks do not have image generated or scored.Some scores are also withheld because the VLM judge does not correctly ground evidence. Finally, our evaluation is cost more requiring 59.5 VLM reads per image on average.
blocks.zh: 限制。 GenOlympiad专注于当前边疆模型发现难度的提示,因此分数并不代表其在简单提示上的性能. 此外,GenOlympiad为非边境T2I型号提供有限的信号. GenOlympiad中的一些提示时间太长,无法适应开量模型的背景,因此对于一些开源模型来说,约20项任务没有图像生成或得分. 一些分数被扣,因为VLM法官没有正确证明证据. 最后,我们的评估费用需要59.5个甚高分辨率数据,平均每幅图像读取。

blocks.en: Although we try to design different axes to measure different capabilities of T2I models, it is unavoidable that there are still many overlaps between prompts not only in the same axes, but also in different axes. For example, physical consistency contains many tasks that is the combination of latent computation and world-knowledge grounding . Text fidelity is also unavoidable to have some tasks that requires quantitative precision e.g. , there should be 12 lines of text end with -ation. So we further measure the correlation between axes. The correlation matrix can be seen in Fig. 11 . Most pairs of axes have low correlation, while several pairs even show negative correlation.
blocks.zh: 尽管我们试图设计不同的轴来测量T2I模型的不同能力,但不可避免的是,不仅在同一轴上,而且在不同轴上,提示之间仍然有很多重叠. 例如,物理一致性包含许多任务,即潜在计算和世界知识基础的结合。 文本的忠实性也不可避免地需要完成一些需要数量精确的任务,例如,应当有12行文本以 - 表示结尾。 因此,我们进一步衡量轴之间的关联。 相关矩阵见图11。 大多数对轴的关联性较低,而数对轴甚至显示出负相关.

blocks.en: We take a classic statistics method called partial correlation to calculate the correlation between each axis. We do not directly compare the scores of two axes, because stronger models usually get higher scores on many axes at the same time. So we take methods to mitigate the bias from models’ capability by using linear regression. For each axis, we first predict what score a model should get based on its overall performance using linear regression shown in Fig. 10 . We then compare whether the model performs better or worse than this expected score on different axes. For example, if models that perform better than expected on latent computation can perform either better or worse than expected on physical consistency , then these two axes have a low spearman correlation.
blocks.zh: 我们用一种叫做部分关联的经典统计方法来计算每个轴之间的关联. 我们并不直接比较两个轴的分数,因为较强的模型通常同时在许多轴上获得更高的分数. 因此,我们采取方法,通过使用线性回归来减轻模型能力的偏差。 对于每个轴,我们首先预测一个模型应该用图10所示的线性回归来根据其总体性能获得什么分数. 然后我们比较模型在不同的轴上表现是否优于预期得分. 例如,如果在潜在计算上表现优于预期的模型在物理一致性上能够表现优于或劣于预期,那么这两个轴具有较低的矛手相关性.

blocks.en: A.3 How do we build GenOlympiad?
blocks.zh: A.3 联合国 我们怎样建造GenOlympiad?

blocks.en: We designed an automated agentic task generate protocol to help us create high quality tasks. We provide simplified prompts of the protocol in Appendix A.4
blocks.zh: 我们设计了一个自动代理任务生成协议,帮助我们创建高质量的任务. 我们提供了附录A中议定书的简化提示。

blocks.en: This protocol is made up of several parts. We first build about 1600 task descriptions by using a brainstorming agent powered by Claude Opus 5. We provided many positive examples and negative examples designed by human, then use the prompt in Appendix A.4 to help us conduct large scale brainstorming. Then we do the following check, filtering, then build tasks to get the final 801 tasks. • Detailed definition of Each Axis . The detailed explanation about each capability axis with examples to guide Claude Opus 5 how to generate tasks. • Few-shot Example for high-quality tasks . We manually designed several origin T2I prompts for each capability as few-shot examples for agent. Each prompt reveals a typical fail of GPT-Image-2. • Example to build evaluation program . We designed a modular evaluation framework consists of 43 operators, each operator contains an atomic operation e.g. , Cut the image by using coordination we provide. • Remove low quality tasks . We designed few-shot samples for agent to let it know what the low quality tasks look like, and prevent it from creating low quality tasks such as doing a very simple change like changing ‘counting apples’ to ‘counting footballs’. • Remove easy tasks . We have a difficulty review mechanism that can filter easy tasks out and keep difficult tasks. While building the benchmark, we conduct the review using five frontier T2I models: GPT-Image-2, Nano Banana 2, GPT-Image-1.5, FLUX.2 pro, and Seedream-4.5. A task is kept if at least two models receive a score, fewer than three models receive a full score of 100, and either the average score is below 35, or the average score is below 60 with at least one model receiving a score of 0. This keeps tasks that some models can solve but others fail, so our benchmark can better distinguish different models.

blocks.en: Each prompt below looks ordinary, but frontier T2I models fail it for a reason that can be named. Where we recorded the outcome of our first trials, it is given after the prompt. 1. Exact geometry of a technical drawing. Generate a precise 2D CAD-style engineering drawing in strict orthographic front view of a flat mechanical panel. Visual style: - pure white background - thin black uniform lines - no perspective - no shading - no textures - no shadows - no color - no text - no dimension annotations - geometry only - crisp technical drawing appearance Geometry: 1. Outer boundary: a rectangle of width 300 units and height 200 units. 2. At the geometric center of the rectangle, draw two concentric circles: - outer circle diameter 60 units - inner circle diameter 30 units 3. Draw four identical circular holes of diameter 16 units, centered at: - (60, 150) - (240, 150) - (60, 50) - (240, 50) 4. Draw a horizontal slot centered at (150, 50), with total length 120 units and height 12 units, semicircular ends. 5. Draw two vertical rectangular slots, each width 12 units and height 70 units: - left slot center at (110, 100) - right slot center at (190, 100) 6. Draw a square cutout of side length 24 units centered at (150, 150). 7. The square cutout must be exactly centered horizontally with the concentric circles. 8. The two vertical slots must be symmetric about the vertical centerline of the plate. 9. All geometry must preserve exact proportions, alignment, symmetry, spacing, and relative size. Important: - The output must be a clean technical diagram. - All relative measurements must be preserved exactly. - Do not artistically reinterpret the drawing. 2. Two tilted mirrors. Two identical mirrors on a vanity, one tilted 10 degrees backward, one 10 degrees forward. A person at equal distance appears full-body in the backward-tilted mirror but cut off at the feet in the forward-tilted one. 3. Tree rings with an exact count. A polished 60cm tree-trunk cross-section with exactly 47 concentric annual rings, a label reading ‘Tree age: 47 years’, a centimeter scale along the edge, plus two visibly narrow drought-ring clusters and one wide optimal-growth band at specific radii. 4. Falling Slinky. A 0.6m metallic Slinky released from rest is photographed mid-fall: the top coils have collapsed and fallen ∼ \sim 3m while the bottom end remains motionless at the release height, the coils forming a compressed cluster whose spacing increases non-linearly from bottom to top. 5. Text printed on one grain of rice. A realistic macro photograph of a white ceramic plate filled with uncooked white rice grains. The camera is very close to the plate, with shallow depth of field, but the rice grains must remain individually visible. In the exact center of the image, there is one single rice grain lying horizontally on top of the pile. On this one rice grain, write the tiny black printed text: ‘GPT-IMAGE-2’ The text must be physically printed directly on the surface of that rice grain, following the grain’s curved shape. The letters must be extremely small but still clearly readable when zoomed in. Do not write any text on the plate, table, background, or other rice grains. Only the one central rice grain contains text. The image should look like a real macro lens photo, with natural lighting, realistic shadows, and a believable scale difference between the rice grain and the tiny text. 6. Three mutually consistent annotation panels. Generate a three-panel computer vision annotation benchmark image. The output must contain three equal-sized panels arranged horizontally from left to right, separated by narrow white gutters. Do not add titles, legends, or decorative elements. All three panels must represent the exact same scene with exactly eight apples on a kitchen table. All three panels must use the same camera view, crop, coordinate system, scale, and object layout. Panel 1: RGB image. A realistic RGB photograph of a kitchen table with exactly eight apples. The apples should vary in size, color, rotation, and pose. Some apples should touch or slightly overlap each other, but every apple must remain at least partially visible as a separate instance. Use realistic lighting, shadows, and perspective. Panel 2: instance segmentation mask. A clean pixel-aligned instance segmentation mask of Panel 1. Each of the eight apples must be represented by a different flat solid color, chosen from this fixed set: red, blue, green, yellow, magenta, cyan, orange, and purple. The table and background must be pure white. The mask must exactly match the visible shapes, boundaries, positions, scales, and occlusion relationships of the apples in Panel 1. Hidden parts of occluded apples must not appear in the mask. Do not include text, labels, outlines, shadows, gradients, or textures. Panel 3: object detection bounding box annotation. A clean annotation view of the same scene from Panel 1. Use a pure white background and draw exactly eight tight axis-aligned rectangular bounding boxes, one around each apple. Each bounding box must tightly enclose the full visible apple, including the visible stem if present. Each box must use the same color as the corresponding apple instance in Panel 2. Add a small numeric label from 1 to 8 at the top-left corner of each bounding box. Do not draw any extra boxes. Do not miss any apple. Do not render the apples themselves in Panel 3; show only the white background, the eight colored bounding boxes, and the numeric labels. Define instance identity consistently across all panels by sorting apples from left to right according to the x-coordinate of their visible-region centroids; if two apples have similar x-coordinates, break ties from top to bottom. The apple assigned identity 1 corresponds to label 1, identity 2 corresponds to label 2, and so on. The three panels must be mutually consistent. The same apple instance must have the same identity, position, size, overlap relationship, and visible extent across Panel 1, Panel 2, and Panel 3. 7. A chat screenshot whose picture contradicts its text. Generate a fictional AI chat screenshot used as a visual benchmark example. The chat interface shows a user prompt that confidently asks: ‘Draw a human hand with exactly five fingers. The final image must contain only five fingers.’ The assistant response appears to comply and says: ‘Here is a realistic hand with exactly five fingers.’ However, the generated image shown under the assistant response clearly depicts a realistic human hand with six fingers. The sixth finger should be visible but not exaggerated, making the failure subtle at first glance but undeniable upon inspection. Use a clean modern chat UI layout, rounded bubbles, white background, and a realistic image preview. The scene should demonstrate an instruction-following failure: the prompt asks for five fingers, but the output contains six. Do not use real ChatGPT logos, OpenAI logos, or any real platform branding. This must be a fictional mockup. 8. Offside at the moment of the pass. (translated) Generate a realistic football match scene that captures the exact moment of a pass. The image must clearly show the passer, the receiver, at least three defenders, the direction of the goal, and the pitch markings. At the moment of the pass the receiver must be in an offside position: the receiver must be behind or level with the second-to-last defender. The ball must be clearly leaving the passer’s foot at the moment of the pass. 9. Gomoku, one move from winning. (translated) Generate a realistic top-down view of a gomoku game that shows a plausible position, in which every stone is placed with a tactical purpose. Do not place stones at random. Black needs only one move to win: one more black move makes five in a row, but in the current image Black must not already have five in a row. White should have several sensible defensive stones nearby that block or counter Black’s attack. The stones elsewhere on the board should also be laid out sensibly, as in a real mid-to-late game. Render the board as a clean wooden gomoku board, with black and white stones placed exactly on the intersections, viewed from directly above. 10. A bar chart that describes its own image. (translated) Generate a realistic office scene. On the wall there is a large whiteboard titled ‘Color distribution of this image’. The whiteboard shows a bar chart with four bars, labelled green, white, brown and blue. The heights of the four bars must accurately reflect the proportions of the pixels that are actually visible as green, white, brown and blue in the whole image. The room should contain green plants, white walls, brown wooden furniture and blue objects, so that all four colors are clearly present. The bar chart must be large, clearly legible and easy to measure visually. 11. Sheet music from LilyPond code. (translated) Generate a clear black-and-white engraved sheet-music image from the following LilyPond code. The output must be a standard score excerpt on a white page, presented as a single treble staff. The clef, key signature, time signature, pickup measure, bar lines, pitches, durations, rests, ties and slurs must match the code exactly. Do not add extra notes, lyrics, fingerings, decorative graphics or unrelated annotations. The engraving should look like printed sheet music, not handwritten music. LilyPond code: \version "2.24.0" \paper { indent = 0\mm line-width = 160\mm tagline = ##f } \layout { ragged-right = ##t } melody = \relative c’’ { \clef treble \key a \minor \time 3/8 \tempo "Poco moto" \partial 8 e16 dis | e16 dis e b d c | a8 r16 c e a | b8 r16 e gis b | c8 r16 e dis e | } \score { \new Staff \melody } The ground-truth image is rendered from the same code with LilyPond. 12. Conway’s Game of Life, first grid. Generate a clean black-and-white grid image showing the final state of Conway’s Game of Life after 4 steps. Use standard Conway’s Game of Life rules on a finite grid with dead cells outside the boundary. Black squares are live cells and white squares are dead cells. Initial 10 × \times 10 grid: 0000000000 0000000000 0001000000 0000100000 0011100000 0000000000 0000000000 0000000000 0000000000 0000000000 Render only the final 10 × \times 10 grid after exactly 4 steps. Draw each cell as a sharp square. Do not add coordinates, labels, text, arrows, or decorative elements. The ground-truth image is computed with a Python program. 13. Conway’s Game of Life, second grid. Generate a clean black-and-white grid image showing the final state of Conway’s Game of Life after 4 steps. Use standard Conway’s Game of Life rules on a finite grid with dead cells outside the boundary. Black squares are live cells and white squares are dead cells. Initial 12 × \times 12 grid: 000000000000 000001000000 000011100000 000000100000 000110000000 000101100000 000000000000 000001110000 000000010000 000000000000 000000000000 000000000000 Render only the final 12 × \times 12 grid after exactly 4 steps. Draw each cell as a sharp square. Do not add coordinates, labels, text, arrows, borders outside the grid, or decorative elements. The ground-truth image is computed with a Python program. 14. Complex mirror and occlusion relations. (translated) A view in front of a bathroom mirror. A bottle of shower gel stands on the counter. Behind the shower gel there is a bunch of keys. The keys are visible only in the mirror, because from the viewer’s position they are hidden by the shower gel. The reflection in the mirror shows the complete back of the shower gel bottle. The reflection also contains an analog clock showing 11:07:47, and the picture in the mirror is mirrored. Observed: GPT-Image-2 fails; Seedream fails. 15. Most of the subject is not visible directly, but the whole is visible indirectly. (translated) A street scene in realistic photo style. There is a small puddle on the ground in the foreground. On the right side of the frame only the front half of a bicycle can be seen directly: the front wheel, the handlebars and a short piece of the frame. The rear half and the rider’s body are outside the edge of the frame or cropped, so the rider and the whole bicycle cannot be seen directly and completely in the main picture. However, in the reflection in the foreground puddle, the complete bicycle and the person riding it must be visible: both wheels, the whole frame, the saddle, and the rider’s upper body and head. The complete bicycle and rider in the reflection must be consistent in position and orientation with the part of the bicycle that is visible in the main picture. The complete rider must not appear directly in the main picture, only in the puddle reflection. The whole image should look like a real street photograph. Observed: GPT-Image-2 fails; Seedream is correct. 16. A very large search space with an explicit global constraint. (translated) Generate a picture of a maze. Only three paths lead from the start to the end. Mark these three paths in different colors. Observed: GPT-Image-2 fails; Seedream fails. 17. Complex topology. (translated) A desk scene in realistic photo style. On the desk there are a black fountain pen and a pair of white wired earphones. The earphone cable is wound once around the pen. On the left side of the pen the cable passes over the pen and hides it; on the right side of the pen the cable goes under the pen and is hidden by it. The cable must be one continuous unbroken white line, and the pen must stay straight and must not be cut by the cable. The crossings must show a clear front-and-back relation and natural shadows. Observed: GPT-Image-2 fails; Seedream fails. 18. A large number that must be shown exactly. (translated) A clean top-down photograph. Exactly 37 red M&M chocolate candies are scattered on an ordinary wooden table. Each candy is clearly separated and can be counted individually. There is nothing else on the table. Observed: GPT-Image-2 fails; Seedream fails. We also noted four failures without keeping the prompt text: dice whose pips should sum to a given number (the image summed to 58, which was wrong); a vernier caliper that should read 23.64 (wrong reading); a concave mirror magnifying a coin; and a plate of 20 grapes with a chart of them, where the chart was drawn wrong.

左槽中心位于(110,100) - 右槽中心位于(190,100) 6. 以(150,150)为中心的24个单元的侧长度划出一个方形。 7. 平方切口必须与同心圆完全横向中心。 8. 两个垂直槽必须对板块的垂直中心线进行对称. 9. 所有几何必须保持精确比例、对称、对称、间隔和相对大小。 重要的: - 输出必须是干净的技术图. - 所有相对的测量必须准确保存。 不要在艺术上重新解释绘画。 2. 两面倾斜的镜子。 虚空上两面相同的镜子,一面向后倾斜10度,向前倾斜10度. 距离相等的一个人在反斜面的镜子中出现全身,但在前斜面的脚下被切断. 3. 树环精确计数. 被抛光的60厘米树圈截面,全年有47个同心圆环,标签读作“Tree ages:47岁”,边缘有厘米的尺度,加上两个明显狭窄的旱圈星团和一个特定弧度的宽最佳生长带。 4. 坠落的斯林基。 从休息中释放出来的0.6m的金属斯林基被拍摄到中秋:顶端的线圈已经坍塌并倒塌 \ sim 3m,而底端在释放高度时仍然没有运动,线圈形成一个压缩的集群,其间距从下到上从无线增加. 5. 一粒米上印的文字。 现实主义的宏观照片 白色陶瓷板上装满了未煮熟的白米粒. 相机离板很近,田间深度较浅,但稻谷必须保持单独可见. 在画面的正中央,有一个单粒米粒水平地躺在堆积物的上方. 在这颗米粒上,写上黑色的小字: " GPT-IMAGE-2 " 文字必须直接印在稻谷表面, 字母必须极小,但缩放后仍可清晰读取. 不要在盘子,桌子,背景,或其他米粒上写任何文字. 只有中央米谷包含文字. 画面应外观为真实的宏观镜头照片,具有自然的照明,现实的影子,米粒与细小的文字之间有不可思议的尺度差异. 6. 三个相互一致的说明板。 生成一个三层计算机视野注释基准图像. 输出必须包含从左到右横向排列的三块等大小的面板,由狭长的白沟隔开. 不添加标题、 传说或装饰元素 。 三个面板必须代表完全相同的场景 厨房桌上有八颗苹果 所有三个面板都必须使用相同的相机视图,裁剪,坐标系统,尺度,以及对象布局. 第1小组:RGB图像. 一张现实的RGB照片 一个厨房桌子上八颗苹果 苹果的大小,颜色,旋转,姿势都应该有不同. 有些苹果应该互相触摸或略有重叠,但每个苹果必须至少保持部分可见作为单独的例子. 使用现实的照明,阴影和视角. 第2小组:实例分割罩。 1号面板的清洁像素对齐实例分割罩. 八颗苹果中的每一颗都必须用不同的扁平固体颜色来代表,从这组固定颜色中选择:红,蓝,绿,黄,紫,青,橙,紫. 桌子和背景必须是纯白色的. 面具必须精确匹配第一小组苹果的可见形状,边界,位置,鳞片,以及隐蔽关系. 隐蔽的苹果部分不得出现在面具中. 不包括文字,标签,大纲,阴影,梯度,或纹理. 第3小组:物体探测边框注释。 第1小组对同一场景的清晰说明。 使用纯白色背景,并精确地画出8个紧轴对齐的矩形边框,每个苹果环绕一个. 每一边框必须紧紧地将整个可见的苹果,包括存在的可见的干子. 每个框必须使用与第2小组中相应的苹果实例相同的颜色. 在每个边框的左上角加上一个从1到8的小数字标签。 不要绘制额外的框 。 不要错过任何苹果。 不要在第三小组中让苹果自己变形;只显示白色背景,八色边框和数字标签. 在所有面板上一致定义实例身份,根据可见区域百分数的x坐标从左到右排序苹果;如果两个苹果有相似的x坐标,则从上到下断开联系. 苹果指定身份1对应标签1,身份2对应标签2等. 这三个小组必须相互一致。 同一个苹果实例在第一小组、第二小组和第三小组必须具有相同的特性、位置、大小、重叠关系和可见程度。 7. 聊天截图,其图片与其文本相矛盾。 生成一个虚构的AI聊天截图,作为视觉基准实例. 聊天界面显示一个有自信地问道的用户提示:‘用精确的五个手指画一只人手. 最后的图像只须包含五根手指。 助理的答复似乎听从了,并说:`这是一只实事求是的手,有五个手指。 ' 然而,在助理响应下显示的生成的图像清晰地描绘出一个有6个手指的现实的人类手. 第六个手指应该看得见,但不能夸大其词,使失败乍一看就变得微妙,但检查时却不可否认。 使用干净的现代聊天UI布局,圆形气泡,白色背景,以及现实的图像预览. 场景应显示一个指令后续失败: 及时要求5个手指,但输出包含6个. 不要使用真实的ChatGPT标志,OpenAI标志,或者任何真实的平台品牌. 这一定是个虚构的模型 8. 通行时离席。 创造出现实的足球比赛场景,捕捉出一个传球的准确时刻. 画面必须明确显示传球手,接收者,至少三个卫士,球门方向,投球标记. 在通过时,接收器必须处于离岸位置:接收器必须落后或与第二对后卫同位. 球必须在传球时明确离开传球手的脚. 9. 悟空,从胜一步. (翻译) 生成一个现实的自上而下视图,显示一个可信的位置,每块石头都带有战术目的. 不要随意放置石头。 黑色只需一个动作即可获胜:再一个黑色动作可以连续5次,但在当前图像中 布莱克一定还没有连续五个 白色应该有数块合理的防御石 在附近阻挡或反击布莱克的攻击。 板子上其他地方的石块也应明智地铺设,就像真正的中晚期游戏一样. 将板子作为干净的木头木板,黑白石块完全放置在十字路口上,直接从上面看. 10. 描述其自身形象的条形图。 (译)产生现实的办公场景. 墙上有一个大白板, 白板显示一个条形图,上面有四条条,标有绿色,白色,棕色和蓝色的标签. 四条条的高度必须准确反映整个图像中实际可见的绿色,白色,棕色和蓝色等像素的比例. 房间应包含绿色植物,白色墙壁,棕色木质家具和蓝色物品,这样所有四种颜色都明显存在. 条形图必须大、清晰、易视。 11. 来自LilyPond代码的单曲音乐. 从下面的LilyPond代码中生成一个清晰的黑白刻制表音乐图像. 产出必须是白页上的标准分数节录,作为单倍制工作人员呈现. 网格,密钥签名,时间签名,取货量度,条线,投球,持续时间,休息,领带和滑槽必须准确匹配代码. 不添加额外的音符,歌词,指法,装饰图形或无关的注释. 雕刻应像印刷页音乐,而不是手写音乐. blocks.en: Three mutually consistent annotation panels. Generate a three-panel computer vision annotation benchmark image. The output must contain three equal-sized panels arranged horizontally from left to right, separated by narrow white gutters. Do not add titles, legends, or decorative elements. All three panels must represent the exact same scene with exactly eight apples on a kitchen table. All three panels must use the same camera view, crop, coordinate system, scale, and object layout. Panel 1: RGB image. A realistic RGB photograph of a kitchen table with exactly eight apples. The apples should vary in size, color, rotation, and pose. Some apples should touch or slightly overlap each other, but every apple must remain at least partially visible as a separate instance. Use realistic lighting, shadows, and perspective. Panel 2: instance segmentation mask. A clean pixel-aligned instance segmentation mask of Panel 1. Each of the eight apples must be represented by a different flat solid color, chosen from this fixed set: red, blue, green, yellow, magenta, cyan, orange, and purple. The table and background must be pure white. The mask must exactly match the visible shapes, boundaries, positions, scales, and occlusion relationships of the apples in Panel 1. Hidden parts of occluded apples must not appear in the mask. Do not include text, labels, outlines, shadows, gradients, or textures. Panel 3: object detection bounding box annotation. A clean annotation view of the same scene from Panel 1. Use a pure white background and draw exactly eight tight axis-aligned rectangular bounding boxes, one around each apple. Each bounding box must tightly enclose the full visible apple, including the visible stem if present. Each box must use the same color as the corresponding apple instance in Panel 2. Add a small numeric label from 1 to 8 at the top-left corner of each bounding box. Do not draw any extra boxes. Do not miss any apple. Do not render the apples themselves in Panel 3; show only the white background, the eight colored bounding boxes, and the numeric labels. Define instance identity consistently across all panels by sorting apples from left to right according to the x-coordinate of their visible-region centroids; if two apples have similar x-coordinates, break ties from top to bottom. The apple assigned identity 1 corresponds to label 1, identity 2 corresponds to label 2, and so on. The three panels must be mutually consistent. The same apple instance must have the same identity, position, size, overlap relationship, and visible extent across Panel 1, Panel 2, and Panel 3.
blocks.zh: 三个相互一致的注释面板. 生成一个三层计算机视野注释基准图像. 输出必须包含从左到右横向排列的三块等大小的面板,由狭长的白沟隔开. 不添加标题、 传说或装饰元素 。 三个面板必须代表完全相同的场景 厨房桌上有八颗苹果 所有三个面板都必须使用相同的相机视图,裁剪,坐标系统,尺度,以及对象布局. 第1小组:RGB图像. 一张现实的RGB照片 一个厨房桌子上八颗苹果 苹果的大小,颜色,旋转,姿势都应该有不同. 有些苹果应该互相触摸或略有重叠,但每个苹果必须至少保持部分可见作为单独的例子. 使用现实的照明,阴影和视角. 第2小组:实例分割罩。 1号面板的清洁像素对齐实例分割罩. 八颗苹果中的每一颗都必须用不同的扁平固体颜色来代表,从这组固定颜色中选择:红,蓝,绿,黄,紫,青,橙,紫. 桌子和背景必须是纯白色的. 面具必须精确匹配第一小组苹果的可见形状,边界,位置,鳞片,以及隐蔽关系. 隐蔽的苹果部分不得出现在面具中. 不包括文字,标签,大纲,阴影,梯度,或纹理. 第3小组:物体探测边框注释。 第1小组对同一场景的清晰说明。 使用纯白色背景,并精确地画出8个紧轴对齐的矩形边框,每个苹果环绕一个. 每一边框必须紧紧地将整个可见的苹果,包括存在的可见的干子. 每个框必须使用与第2小组中相应的苹果实例相同的颜色. 在每个边框的左上角加上一个从1到8的小数字标签。 不要绘制额外的框 。 不要错过任何苹果。 不要在第三小组中让苹果自己变形;只显示白色背景,八色边框和数字标签. 在所有面板上一致定义实例身份,根据可见区域百分数的x坐标从左到右排序苹果;如果两个苹果有相似的x坐标,则从上到下断开联系. 苹果指定身份1对应标签1,身份2对应标签2等. 三个小组必须相互一致。 同一个苹果实例在第一小组、第二小组和第三小组必须具有相同的特性、位置、大小、重叠关系和可见程度。

blocks.en: A chat screenshot whose picture contradicts its text. Generate a fictional AI chat screenshot used as a visual benchmark example. The chat interface shows a user prompt that confidently asks: ‘Draw a human hand with exactly five fingers. The final image must contain only five fingers.’ The assistant response appears to comply and says: ‘Here is a realistic hand with exactly five fingers.’ However, the generated image shown under the assistant response clearly depicts a realistic human hand with six fingers. The sixth finger should be visible but not exaggerated, making the failure subtle at first glance but undeniable upon inspection. Use a clean modern chat UI layout, rounded bubbles, white background, and a realistic image preview. The scene should demonstrate an instruction-following failure: the prompt asks for five fingers, but the output contains six. Do not use real ChatGPT logos, OpenAI logos, or any real platform branding. This must be a fictional mockup.
blocks.zh: 聊天截图,其图片与文本相矛盾 。 生成一个虚构的AI聊天截图,作为视觉基准实例. 聊天界面显示一个有自信地问道的用户提示:‘用精确的五个手指画一只人手. 最后的图像只须包含五根手指。 助理的答复似乎听从了,并说:`这是一只实事求是的手,有五个手指。 ' 然而,在助理响应下显示的生成的图像清晰地描绘出一个有6个手指的现实的人类手. 第六个手指应该看得见,但不能夸大其词,使失败乍一看就变得微妙,但检查时却不可否认。 使用干净的现代聊天UI布局,圆形气泡,白色背景,以及现实的图像预览. 场景应显示一个指令后续失败: 及时要求5个手指,但输出包含6个. 不要使用真实的ChatGPT标志,OpenAI标志,或者任何真实的平台品牌. 这一定是虚构的假象

blocks.en: Offside at the moment of the pass. (translated) Generate a realistic football match scene that captures the exact moment of a pass. The image must clearly show the passer, the receiver, at least three defenders, the direction of the goal, and the pitch markings. At the moment of the pass the receiver must be in an offside position: the receiver must be behind or level with the second-to-last defender. The ball must be clearly leaving the passer’s foot at the moment of the pass.
blocks.zh: 出关之时. 创造出现实的足球比赛场景,捕捉出一个传球的准确时刻. 画面必须明确显示传球手,接收者,至少三个卫士,球门方向,投球标记. 在通过时,接收器必须处于离岸位置:接收器必须落后或与第二对后卫同位. 球必须在传球时明确离开传球手的脚.

blocks.en: Gomoku, one move from winning. (translated) Generate a realistic top-down view of a gomoku game that shows a plausible position, in which every stone is placed with a tactical purpose. Do not place stones at random. Black needs only one move to win: one more black move makes five in a row, but in the current image Black must not already have five in a row. White should have several sensible defensive stones nearby that block or counter Black’s attack. The stones elsewhere on the board should also be laid out sensibly, as in a real mid-to-late game. Render the board as a clean wooden gomoku board, with black and white stones placed exactly on the intersections, viewed from directly above.
blocks.zh: 悟空,从胜一动. 生成一个现实的自上而下视角,显示一个可信的位置,每块石头都有一个战术目的. 不要随意放置石头。 黑色只需一个动作即可获胜:再一个黑色动作可以连续5次,但在当前图像中 布莱克一定还没有连续五个 白色应该有数块合理的防御石 在附近阻挡或反击布莱克的攻击。 板子上其他地方的石块也应明智地铺设,就像真正的中晚期游戏一样. 将板子作为干净的木头木板,黑白石块完全放置在十字路口上,直接从上面看.

blocks.en: A bar chart that describes its own image. (translated) Generate a realistic office scene. On the wall there is a large whiteboard titled ‘Color distribution of this image’. The whiteboard shows a bar chart with four bars, labelled green, white, brown and blue. The heights of the four bars must accurately reflect the proportions of the pixels that are actually visible as green, white, brown and blue in the whole image. The room should contain green plants, white walls, brown wooden furniture and blue objects, so that all four colors are clearly present. The bar chart must be large, clearly legible and easy to measure visually.
blocks.zh: 一个描述自己形象的条形图. (译)产生现实的办公场景. 墙上有一个大白板, 白板显示一个条形图,上面有四条条,标有绿色,白色,棕色和蓝色的标签. 四条条的高度必须准确反映整个图像中实际可见的绿色,白色,棕色和蓝色等像素的比例. 房间应包含绿色植物,白色墙壁,棕色木质家具和蓝色物品,这样所有四种颜色都明显存在. 条形图必须大、清晰、易视。

blocks.en: Sheet music from LilyPond code. (translated) Generate a clear black-and-white engraved sheet-music image from the following LilyPond code. The output must be a standard score excerpt on a white page, presented as a single treble staff. The clef, key signature, time signature, pickup measure, bar lines, pitches, durations, rests, ties and slurs must match the code exactly. Do not add extra notes, lyrics, fingerings, decorative graphics or unrelated annotations. The engraving should look like printed sheet music, not handwritten music. LilyPond code: \version "2.24.0" \paper { indent = 0\mm line-width = 160\mm tagline = ##f } \layout { ragged-right = ##t } melody = \relative c’’ { \clef treble \key a \minor \time 3/8 \tempo "Poco moto" \partial 8 e16 dis | e16 dis e b d c | a8 r16 c e a | b8 r16 e gis b | c8 r16 e dis e | } \score { \new Staff \melody } The ground-truth image is rendered from the same code with LilyPond.
blocks.zh: 从LilyPond代码录制的单曲音乐. 从下面的LilyPond代码中生成一个清晰的黑白刻制表音乐图像. 产出必须是白页上的标准分数节录,作为单倍制工作人员呈现. 网格,密钥签名,时间签名,取货量度,条线,投球,持续时间,休息,领带和滑槽必须准确匹配代码. 不添加额外的音符,歌词,指法,装饰图形或无关的注释. 雕刻应像印刷页音乐,而不是手写音乐. LilyPond代码:\version "2.24.0"\paper { indent = 0\mm 线-width = 160\mm 标记线= ^f}\layout { rigg-right = ^t }旋律=\ relative c}\clef treble\ key a\minor\time 3/8\tempo "Poco Moto"\部分 8 e16 d\ e16 d e e e e e e e e e e e \ 8 r e e e e i i i i i i i i i i i i i i ## 8 e e e e o i i i i i i i i i i o i i i i i i i i o i i i i o i o i i i 地面真实图像由与LilyPond的同一代码渲染而来.

blocks.en: Conway’s Game of Life, first grid. Generate a clean black-and-white grid image showing the final state of Conway’s Game of Life after 4 steps. Use standard Conway’s Game of Life rules on a finite grid with dead cells outside the boundary. Black squares are live cells and white squares are dead cells. Initial 10 × \times 10 grid: 0000000000 0000000000 0001000000 0000100000 0011100000 0000000000 0000000000 0000000000 0000000000 0000000000 Render only the final 10 × \times 10 grid after exactly 4 steps. Draw each cell as a sharp square. Do not add coordinates, labels, text, arrows, or decorative elements. The ground-truth image is computed with a Python program.

Conway’s Game of Life, second grid. Generate a clean black-and-white grid image showing the final state of Conway’s Game of Life after 4 steps. Use standard Conway’s Game of Life rules on a finite grid with dead cells outside the boundary. Black squares are live cells and white squares are dead cells. Initial 12 × \times 12 grid: 000000000000 000001000000 000011100000 000000100000 000110000000 000101100000 000000000000 000001110000 000000010000 000000000000 000000000000 000000000000 Render only the final 12 × \times 12 grid after exactly 4 steps. Draw each cell as a sharp square. Do not add coordinates, labels, text, arrows, borders outside the grid, or decorative elements. The ground-truth image is computed with a Python program.

Complex mirror and occlusion relations. (translated) A view in front of a bathroom mirror. A bottle of shower gel stands on the counter. Behind the shower gel there is a bunch of keys. The keys are visible only in the mirror, because from the viewer’s position they are hidden by the shower gel. The reflection in the mirror shows the complete back of the shower gel bottle. The reflection also contains an analog clock showing 11:07:47, and the picture in the mirror is mirrored. Observed: GPT-Image-2 fails; Seedream fails.
blocks.zh: 复杂的镜像和隔离关系. (翻译) 浴室镜子前的风景 柜台上有一瓶淋浴胶 淋浴胶后面有一堆钥匙 这些钥匙只在镜子中可见,因为从观众的位置看,它们被淋浴凝胶所隐藏. 镜中的反射显示淋浴胶瓶的完整背面. 反射还包含一个模拟时钟,显示11:07:47,反射镜中的照片是反射的. 央视:GPT-Image-2失败;种子梦失败.

blocks.en: Most of the subject is not visible directly, but the whole is visible indirectly. (translated) A street scene in realistic photo style. There is a small puddle on the ground in the foreground. On the right side of the frame only the front half of a bicycle can be seen directly: the front wheel, the handlebars and a short piece of the frame. The rear half and the rider’s body are outside the edge of the frame or cropped, so the rider and the whole bicycle cannot be seen directly and completely in the main picture. However, in the reflection in the foreground puddle, the complete bicycle and the person riding it must be visible: both wheels, the whole frame, the saddle, and the rider’s upper body and head. The complete bicycle and rider in the reflection must be consistent in position and orientation with the part of the bicycle that is visible in the main picture. The complete rider must not appear directly in the main picture, only in the puddle reflection. The whole image should look like a real street photograph. Observed: GPT-Image-2 fails; Seedream is correct.
blocks.zh: 大部分主体不直接可见,但整体间接可见. (译)现实摄影风格的街景. 前方的地面上有一个小水坑。 在框架的右侧,只能直接看到自行车的前半身:前轮,握把杆和框架的一小块. 后半身和骑手的遗体在车架边缘之外或被裁剪,因此骑手和整个自行车无法在主画面中直接和完全看到. 然而,在前排水坑的反射中,完整的自行车和骑自行车的人必须可见:双轮,全帧,马鞍,以及骑手的上身和头部. 反射中完整的自行车和骑手必须在位置和方向上与主画面中可见的自行车部分保持一致. 完整的骑手不得直接出现在主画面中,只能出现在水坑反射中. 整个画面应该像 真正的街道照片。 央视:GPT-Image-2故障;种子梦正确.

blocks.en: A very large search space with an explicit global constraint. (translated) Generate a picture of a maze. Only three paths lead from the start to the end. Mark these three paths in different colors. Observed: GPT-Image-2 fails; Seedream fails.
blocks.zh: 一个巨大的搜索空间,有着明显的全球限制. 生成一幅迷宫的照片. 从头到尾只有三条路 以不同的颜色标出这三条路径 。 央视:GPT-Image-2失败;种子梦失败.

blocks.en: Complex topology. (translated) A desk scene in realistic photo style. On the desk there are a black fountain pen and a pair of white wired earphones. The earphone cable is wound once around the pen. On the left side of the pen the cable passes over the pen and hides it; on the right side of the pen the cable goes under the pen and is hidden by it. The cable must be one continuous unbroken white line, and the pen must stay straight and must not be cut by the cable. The crossings must show a clear front-and-back relation and natural shadows. Observed: GPT-Image-2 fails; Seedream fails.
blocks.zh: 复杂的地形学. (翻译) 以现实摄影风格的桌面场景. 桌上有黑喷泉笔和一对白线耳机. 耳机电缆曾经在钢笔周围受伤过. 在笔的左侧,缆线穿过笔头,并藏起来;在笔的右侧,缆线走在笔下,并藏起来. 缆绳必须是一条连续不断的白线,笔必须直立,不得被缆绳剪断. 过境点必须显示明显的前后关系和自然阴影。 央视:GPT-Image-2失败;种子梦失败.

blocks.en: A large number that must be shown exactly. (translated) A clean top-down photograph. Exactly 37 red M&M chocolate candies are scattered on an ordinary wooden table. Each candy is clearly separated and can be counted individually. There is nothing else on the table. Observed: GPT-Image-2 fails; Seedream fails.
blocks.zh: 必须准确显示大量数据。 一张干净的自上而下的照片。 完全有37个红色的M&M巧克力糖果散落在普通的木制桌子上. 每块糖果明显分离,可以单独计算. 桌上没有别的东西。 央视:GPT-Image-2失败;种子梦失败.

blocks.en: While the benchmark was being built, we added five more examples that became the standard worked examples of the protocol. The idea of each example is ours. For three of them we show the final prompt of the task that was built from the idea. The other two were taught to the agent as ideas only: a spoken walking route that must be drawn as a floor plan, and the parts sheet of a layered 2D character that must assemble into the character. 1. A reversed compass under the noon sun. Draw a clear picture of a hiker’s brass novelty pocket compass lying on an open paper map on a wooden table. Show a bright SUN in the sky on the RIGHT side of the picture. It is SOLAR NOON in the northern hemisphere, so the sun marks the direction of geographic SOUTH. IMPORTANT INSTRUMENT RULE: this is a REVERSED novelty compass – unlike a normal magnetic compass (whose red ‘N’ needle points to geographic NORTH), on THIS compass the red ‘N’ needle points to geographic SOUTH. Because the noon sun marks south, you must draw the red ‘N’ needle pointing straight TOWARD the sun, and print the letter ‘N’ on the rim of the rose on the side nearest the sun (with S opposite it, and E and W on the two sides). Make the sun a large clear icon and the north needle a distinct RED arrow tipped with the letter ‘N’. Do not add any other note or caption. The model tends to draw the compass that it has seen many times, with the red needle pointing away from the sun. 2. The team at the bottom of the table celebrates. A photograph taken from the touchline of a small amateur football ground on a bright afternoon, after the last game of the day. Ordinary local club players, nobody famous, no sponsor logos. A large painted RESULTS BOARD stands behind the pitch, headed ‘SATURDAY LEAGUE - RESULTS’, and carries exactly these two result lines, one under the other, in big clear letters: SWIFTS 1 - 1 OTTERS OTTERS 2 - 0 BADGERS Three clubs played today and each club’s shirts are a plain single colour: the SWIFTS wear YELLOW, the OTTERS wear GREEN, the BADGERS wear PURPLE. Points are the usual three for a win and one for a draw. This club has an odd tradition and the picture must show it: the CAPTAIN OF THE SIDE THAT COMES BOTTOM of that table stands on the grass with BOTH ARMS RAISED STRAIGHT ABOVE HIS HEAD, fists up, in an unmistakable victory pose; and the three SUBSTITUTES OF THE SIDE THAT COMES TOP sit on the bench slumped forward with their HEADS HELD IN BOTH HANDS, elbows on knees. Work the table out from the printed results yourself — I am deliberately not telling you which side comes bottom or which comes top, and I am not telling you which shirt colour does what. Do not print the table, the points or any team’s position anywhere in the picture: the only text in the picture is the board’s heading and the result lines given above. The results board, the celebrating captain and the three slumped substitutes on the bench must all be clearly visible in the same picture, and every shirt colour must be unmistakable. The rule is given in full, but which team comes bottom must be worked out from the printed results. The model tends to let the winning team celebrate.
blocks.zh: 在建立基准时,我们又增加了五个例子,成为议定书的标准实例。 每个例子的想法都是我们的。 对于其中的三个,我们显示了从这个想法中制定的任务的最终动力。 另外两个被教给特工只是作为想法:一个必须作为地板计划绘制的口语行走路线,以及一个必须集成到角色中的分层2D字符的部件表. 1. 午后太阳下反向罗盘。 画一幅清晰的图画, 在画面右侧的天空显示亮亮的SUN. 它是北半球的SOLAR NOON,所以太阳标志着地理上的南方方向. 这与普通的磁性指南针(其红色的`N ' 针指向地理北)不同, 因为正午太阳标记为南,所以你必须画出红色的"N"针直指向太阳,并将字母"N"印在靠近太阳的玫瑰边缘上(与太阳相对的S,两侧的E和W). 让太阳成为大明亮的图标, 不添加任何其他注释或标题。 模型倾向于绘制它多次看到的指南针,红针指向太阳. 2.桌底的队伍庆祝. 照片取自一个小业余足球场的触摸线 在明亮的下午,一天的最后一场比赛之后. 当地普通的俱乐部球员,无名,无赞助商标志. 在投球场后面站着一个大涂装的RESULTS董事会,领导着`SATURDAY LeAGUE - ResULTS ' ,并用大写字母背着这两条结果线,其中一条在另一条下方:SWIFTS 1 - 1 OTERS OTERS 2 - 0 BADGERS 今天有三家俱乐部参加比赛,每个俱乐部的衬衫都是一种明显的单一颜色:SWIFTS穿YELLOW,OTTERS穿GREEN,BADGERS穿PUPLE。 积分通常为胜负3分,平局1分. 这家俱乐部有奇特的传统,画面必须显示: 桌边的Side的队长站在草地上, 双臂抬着他的头, 拳头举起, 姿势无可挑剔的胜利; 和坐在长凳上的Side的三个附属单位, 托普坐在长凳上, 双臂握着头, 肘部跪着。 我故意不告诉你哪一边是下方,哪一边是上方,我也不告诉你哪个衬衫颜色能做什么。 不要在图片的任何地方打印表格,点数或任何团队的位置:图片中唯一的文字是上面给出的棋盘标题和结果行. 成绩板,庆典队长和板凳上三个被压抑的代用品必须都在同一张照片中清晰可见,每一件衬衫颜色都必须是不可抹杀的. 规则是完全给出的,但哪支队伍是下方的,必须从印刷结果中找出来. 模特儿往往让胜球队庆祝.

Show a bright SUN in the sky on the RIGHT side of the picture. It is SOLAR NOON in the northern hemisphere, so the sun marks the direction of geographic SOUTH. IMPORTANT INSTRUMENT RULE: this is a REVERSED novelty compass – unlike a normal magnetic compass (whose red ‘N’ needle points to geographic NORTH), on THIS compass the red ‘N’ needle points to geographic SOUTH. Because the noon sun marks south, you must draw the red ‘N’ needle pointing straight TOWARD the sun, and print the letter ‘N’ on the rim of the rose on the side nearest the sun (with S opposite it, and E and W on the two sides). Make the sun a large clear icon and the north needle a distinct RED arrow tipped with the letter ‘N’. Do not add any other note or caption. The model tends to draw the compass that it has seen many times, with the red needle pointing away from the sun.
blocks.zh: 午后太阳下反转的指南针 画一幅清晰的图画, 在画面右侧的天空显示亮亮的SUN. 它是北半球的SOLAR NOON,所以太阳标志着地理上的南方方向. 这与普通的磁性指南针(其红色的`N ' 针指向地理北)不同, 因为正午太阳标记为南,所以你必须画出红色的"N"针直指向太阳,并将字母"N"印在靠近太阳的玫瑰边缘上(与太阳相对的S,两侧的E和W). 让太阳成为大明亮的图标, 不添加任何其他注释或标题。 模型倾向于绘制它多次看到的指南针,红针指向太阳.

blocks.en: The team at the bottom of the table celebrates. A photograph taken from the touchline of a small amateur football ground on a bright afternoon, after the last game of the day. Ordinary local club players, nobody famous, no sponsor logos. A large painted RESULTS BOARD stands behind the pitch, headed ‘SATURDAY LEAGUE - RESULTS’, and carries exactly these two result lines, one under the other, in big clear letters: SWIFTS 1 - 1 OTTERS OTTERS 2 - 0 BADGERS Three clubs played today and each club’s shirts are a plain single colour: the SWIFTS wear YELLOW, the OTTERS wear GREEN, the BADGERS wear PURPLE. Points are the usual three for a win and one for a draw. This club has an odd tradition and the picture must show it: the CAPTAIN OF THE SIDE THAT COMES BOTTOM of that table stands on the grass with BOTH ARMS RAISED STRAIGHT ABOVE HIS HEAD, fists up, in an unmistakable victory pose; and the three SUBSTITUTES OF THE SIDE THAT COMES TOP sit on the bench slumped forward with their HEADS HELD IN BOTH HANDS, elbows on knees. Work the table out from the printed results yourself — I am deliberately not telling you which side comes bottom or which comes top, and I am not telling you which shirt colour does what. Do not print the table, the points or any team’s position anywhere in the picture: the only text in the picture is the board’s heading and the result lines given above. The results board, the celebrating captain and the three slumped substitutes on the bench must all be clearly visible in the same picture, and every shirt colour must be unmistakable. The rule is given in full, but which team comes bottom must be worked out from the printed results. The model tends to let the winning team celebrate.
blocks.zh: 桌底的队伍庆祝. 照片取自一个小业余足球场的触摸线 在明亮的下午,一天的最后一场比赛之后. 当地普通的俱乐部球员,无名,无赞助商标志. 在投球场后面站着一个大涂装的RESULTS董事会,领导着`SATURDAY LeAGUE - ResULTS ' ,并用大写字母背着这两条结果线,其中一条在另一条下方:SWIFTS 1 - 1 OTERS OTERS 2 - 0 BADGERS 今天有三家俱乐部参加比赛,每个俱乐部的衬衫都是一种明显的单一颜色:SWIFTS穿YELLOW,OTTERS穿GREEN,BADGERS穿PUPLE。 积分通常为胜负3分,平局1分. 这家俱乐部有奇特的传统,画面必须显示: 桌边的Side的队长站在草地上, 双臂抬着他的头, 拳头举起, 姿势无可挑剔的胜利; 和坐在长凳上的Side的三个附属单位, 托普坐在长凳上, 双臂握着头, 肘部跪着。 我故意不告诉你哪一边是下方,哪一边是上方,我也不告诉你哪个衬衫颜色能做什么。 不要在图片的任何地方打印表格,点数或任何团队的位置:图片中唯一的文字是上面给出的棋盘标题和结果行. 成绩板,庆典队长和板凳上三个被压抑的代用品必须都在同一张照片中清晰可见,每一件衬衫颜色都必须是不可抹杀的. 规则是完全给出的,但哪支队伍是下方的,必须从印刷结果中找出来. 模特儿往往让胜球队庆祝.

blocks.en: Each prompt below looks hard, but GPT-Image-2 solves it, although other models may fail. For each one we wrote down why it is a poor task. The agent is told not to create tasks of these kinds. 1. An agent can compute the result and then rewrite the prompt. (translated) Generate an image: three empty cups A, B and C, each with a capacity of 100 ml. Tap A is off (0), tap B runs at 3 ml/s, tap C runs at 10 ml/s. After 8 seconds, draw the correct water level of each cup according to volume = flow rate × \times time (capped when the cup is full). Observed: GPT-Image-2 is correct; Seedream fails. 2. An agent can compute the result and then rewrite the prompt (second example). (translated) A photorealistic illustration of a high-school physics problem. Take g = 10 m/s 2 and ignore air resistance. A small block A of mass 2 kg is released from rest at the top of a smooth incline of height 5 m. The bottom of the incline joins a rough horizontal track of length 4 m with a coefficient of kinetic friction μ \mu = 0.25. After passing the rough track, the block makes a perfectly inelastic collision with a small block B of mass 3 kg that rests at the end of the track, and the two stick together. After the collision the two blocks move together onto a smooth horizontal track and finally fly off horizontally from the edge of a table of height 1.25 m. Draw the final state according to the laws of physics. Observed: GPT-Image-2 is correct; Seedream fails. 3. A language model alone can remove the difficulty. (translated) A desk scene in realistic photo style. A white microwave oven stands in the middle of the desk. The camera faces the front of the microwave squarely, at the height of the centre of the microwave door. Only the front of the microwave, a little of the desk, and the plain wall behind can be seen; the back, top, left side and right side of the microwave cannot be seen. A very eye-catching cat-head-shaped sticky note is stuck in the middle of the back of the microwave. The note is bright pink, its edge has the outline of cat ears, the material is matte paper, the top-left corner curls up slightly, and it is held by a short piece of translucent tape. In the bottom-right corner of the note there are a small red heart and two yellow five-pointed stars, and on it, in clear black handwritten Chinese, is written: ‘Mom is not home today. Your favourite fried chicken is in the microwave.’ The handwriting is neat, and the note is cute and eye-catching. Observed: GPT-Image-2 is correct; Seedream fails. 4. A language model alone can remove the difficulty (second example). (translated) A desk scene in realistic photo style. A thick book lies in the middle of the desk, photographed from directly above and slightly in front. The front cover faces up, and the back cover faces down, flat against the desk. The front cover is pure white, with no text, pattern, label, decoration or stain. However, on the back cover there is a line of huge, striking red Chinese text: ‘Secret answer’. The text is printed in the middle of the back cover, in a very bold typeface and bright red, and is very eye-catching. Observed: GPT-Image-2 is correct; Seedream fails. 5. A simple change of topology, which GPT models handle easily. (translated) A curved strip of paper bent into a half circle. On the outer side of the strip the word OUTSIDE is written repeatedly, and on the inner side the word INSIDE is written repeatedly. From the camera angle both the inner and the outer side can be seen, and each word must appear on the correct surface. Observed: GPT-Image-2 is correct; Seedream fails. 6. Complex relations among many objects, which GPT-Image-2 is good at. (translated) A photorealistic still life that contains exactly eight objects, and all of the following relations must hold at the same time: a red cup is to the left of a blue book; a green ball is above a yellow box; an orange bottle is behind the blue book; a white bowl is in front of the red cup; a purple candle is to the right of the yellow box; a black phone leans against the orange bottle; a pink eraser is inside the white bowl; a brown wooden block is under the green ball. Apart from these eight objects, there must be nothing else. Observed: GPT-Image-2 is correct; Seedream fails. 7. The cause is not visible but its result is visible, which GPT models handle reliably. (translated) A laptop stands on a desk, but from the current viewpoint the desk lamp behind the laptop cannot be seen. The lamp behind the laptop is the only light source. The laptop screen is off. There is a cat under the desk. Observed: GPT-Image-2 is correct; Seedream fails. 8. A precise gear ratio, which GPT models handle reliably. (translated) Three meshing gears in a row: A (10 teeth), B (20 teeth) and C (40 teeth). Each gear has one red tooth pointing straight up. Gear A turns one full revolution. Show the final position of each red tooth. The positions of the three gears must fully obey the laws of physics. Label A, B and C (or left/right) clearly. The image must be photorealistic. Observed: GPT-Image-2 is correct; Seedream fails. 9. A counter-intuitive request that goes against physics, such as reversing the order of objects in a mirror. (translated) A view facing a bathroom mirror. On the counter, from left to right: a red toothbrush, a blue cup, a bottle of yellow soap, and a white box labelled ‘Soap’. In the mirror the left-to-right order of these four objects is reversed, and the text on the box is mirrored too. Observed: GPT-Image-2 is correct; Seedream is correct. From these trials we drew two lessons for the agent. First, a task is weak if its final picture can be described in words, because an agent can compute the result and rewrite the prompt into a simple description. Second, a task is weak if a language model can simplify the prompt, for example by dropping an object that the prompt asks for but that must not be visible.
blocks.zh: 下方的每个提示看起来都很硬,但GPT-Image-2解决了它,尽管其他模型可能失败. 对于每一个我们都记下了为什么这是一项糟糕的任务。 特工被告知不要创造这类任务. 1. 代理人可以计算结果,然后重写提示。 (翻译) 生成一个图像:三个空杯A,B和C,每杯容量100毫升. Tap A 关闭 (0), Tap B 运行时为 3 ml/s, Tap C 运行时为 10 ml/s. 8秒后,根据体积=流量××时间(杯满时封顶)绘制每杯的正确水位. 央视:GPT-Image-2正确;种子梦失败. 2. 代理人可以计算结果,然后重写提示(第二例). (译)高校物理问题照片现实主义插图. 取g=10 m/s 2,并忽略空气阻力. 一个质量为2千克的小块A在5米高的平滑凹陷处从休息中释放出来. 猪笼草的底部加入4米长的粗糙水平轨,其动力学摩擦系数为μ\mu=0.25. 穿过粗糙的轨道后,该块与位于轨道末端的3公斤质量的B小块发生完全无弹性的碰撞,两块粘合在一起. 碰撞后,两个区块一起移动到平滑的横向轨道上,最后从高度1.25米的桌子边缘水平飞行。 根据物理定律绘制最终状态. 央视:GPT-Image-2正确;种子梦失败. 3. 仅一种语言模式就可以消除困难。 (译)一张现实摄影风格的桌上场景. 一个白色微波炉站在桌子中间 相机正对微波门前方,位于微波门中心高度. 只见微波炉前部,稍有台面,后部平面墙壁;微波炉后部,顶部,左侧和右侧无法看见. 一个非常捕眼的猫头鹰形状的粘结纸条卡在微波炉后部的中间. 音符为明亮的粉红色,其边缘有猫耳的轮廓,材料为垫纸,左上角略向上卷曲,被短片的半透明胶带所持有. 音符右下角有一颗小红心和两颗黄五角星,上面用明确的黑色手写中文写道:‘妈妈今天不在家. 你最喜欢的炸鸡在微波炉里。 笔迹整齐,笔记又可爱又捕眼. 央视:GPT-Image-2正确;种子梦失败. 4. 仅一个语言模型就可以消除困难(第二个例子)。 (译)一张现实摄影风格的桌上场景. 一张厚厚的书放在桌子的中间,从正上方拍下来,略微放在前面. 前盖面朝上,后盖面朝下,平面对桌子. 前盖纯白色,没有文字,图案,标签,装饰或污点. 然而,在背面的封面上有一行巨大的,引人注目的红色中文文本:‘秘密回答'. 文字印在后盖中间,用非常粗体的字形和明亮的红色印刷,非常捕眼. 央视:GPT-Image-2正确;种子梦失败. 5. 简单改变地形,GPT模型很容易处理。 弯成半圆的条状纸 条条外侧的OutSIDE字反复写,内侧的INSIDE字反复写. 从相机角度可以看到内侧和外侧,每个词必须出现在正确的表面. 央视:GPT-Image-2正确;种子梦失败. 6. GPT-Image-2擅长的许多物体之间的复杂关系。 (翻译) 一个光现实主义的静生,其中完全包含八个物体,以下所有关系必须同时保持:一个红杯在蓝书左边;一个绿球在黄盒上方;一个橙瓶在蓝书后面;一个白碗在红杯前面;一个紫烛在黄盒右边;一个黑手机在橙瓶上斜;一个粉红色的擦拭器在白碗里面;一个棕色的木块在绿球下面. 除此八物外,必无别物. 央视:GPT-Image-2正确;种子梦失败. 7. 原因不明显,但结果明显,GPT模型可靠处理。 一台手提电脑放在桌子上,但从目前的观点看,无法看到手提电脑后面的台灯。 笔记本电脑后面的灯是唯一的光源. 笔记本电脑屏幕关闭了 桌子下面有只猫 央视:GPT-Image-2正确;种子梦失败. 8. 精确齿轮比,GPT模型可靠处理。 (翻译) 连续三套 Meting gass in a : A(10齿), B(20齿)和 C(40齿). 每个齿轮都有一个红牙指向直立. 齿轮 一场彻底的革命 显示每颗红牙的最终位置. 三齿轮的位置必须完全遵守物理定律. 标签A、B和C(或左/右)。 图像必须是光现实主义的. 央视:GPT-Image-2正确;种子梦失败. 9. 反直觉请求与物理相悖,如反转镜中物体的顺序. (译)一景面对浴室镜. 在柜台上,从左到右:一个红色牙刷,一个蓝色杯子,一瓶黄色肥皂,以及一个标有"肥皂"字样的白色盒子. 在镜像中,这四个对象的左对右顺序被反转,盒子上的文字也被反转. 央视:GBT-Image-2正确;种子梦正确. 我们从这些审判中吸取了两个教训。 首先,如果一个任务的最终画面可以用文字来描述,那么它就很弱,因为一个代理可以计算结果,并将提示重写成简单的描述. 第二,如果一个语言模型能够简化提示,例如通过丢弃提示要求但不能可见的对象,那么任务就很薄弱.
